hints.title: Active and Working Drivers Definitions
hints.text: An active driver joined on or before the month end. A working driver accepted at least one ride during that specific month.

hints.title: Distinct Working Drivers Counting
hints.text: Count distinct accepted ride driver_id values in the month.

hints.title: Ratio Calculation and Zero Handling
hints.text: Calculate round(ifnull(working_count * 100.0 / nullif(active_count, 0), 0), 2) to prevent division by zero.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RECURSIVE Months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month + 1 FROM Months WHERE month < 12
),
ActiveDrivers AS (
    SELECT m.month,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Drivers d WHERE d.join_date <= LAST_DAY(CONCAT('2020-', LPAD(m.month, 2, '0'), '-01'))) AS active_count
    FROM Months m
),
WorkingDrivers AS (
    SELECT m.month,
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ar.driver_id) FROM AcceptedRides ar JOIN Rides r ON ar.ride_id = r.ride_id WHERE YEAR(r.requested_at) = 2020 AND MONTH(r.requested_at) = m.month) AS working_count
    FROM Months m
)
SELECT a.month,
       ROUND(IFNULL(w.working_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.active_count, 0), 0), 2) AS working_percentage
FROM ActiveDrivers a
JOIN WorkingDrivers w ON a.month = w.month
ORDER BY a.month;
```

complexity.notes: Computes monthly active capacity and working utilization across all 12 calendar buckets.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to wrap active count with nullif causes division by zero exceptions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual CTEs structure independent driver cohorts before computing utilization percentage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling division by zero safely while tracking cumulative and non-cumulative monthly metrics.

WITH RECURSIVE Months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month + 1 FROM Months WHERE month < 12
),
ActiveDrivers AS (
    SELECT m.month,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Drivers d WHERE d.join_date <= (TO_DATE(CONCAT('2020-', LPAD(CAST(m.month AS TEXT), 2, '0'), '-01'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date) AS active_count
    FROM Months m
),
WorkingDrivers AS (
    SELECT m.month,
           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ar.driver_id) FROM AcceptedRides ar JOIN Rides r ON ar.ride_id = r.ride_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.requested_at) = 2020 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.requested_at) = m.month) AS working_count
    FROM Months m
)
SELECT a.month,
       ROUND(COALESCE(w.working_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(a.active_count, 0), 0), 2) AS working_percentage
FROM ActiveDrivers a
JOIN WorkingDrivers w ON a.month = w.month
ORDER BY a.month;

import pandas as pd

def hopper_company_queries_ii(drivers: pd.DataFrame, rides: pd.DataFrame, accepted_rides: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    months_df = pd.DataFrame({'month': list(range(1, 13))})
    drivers['join_date'] = pd.to_datetime(drivers['join_date'])
    rides['requested_at'] = pd.to_datetime(rides['requested_at'])
    merged = rides.merge(accepted_rides, on='ride_id')
    rides_2020 = merged[merged['requested_at'].dt.year == 2020].copy()
    rides_2020['month'] = rides_2020['requested_at'].dt.month
    working_count = rides_2020.groupby('month')['driver_id'].nunique().to_dict()
    percentages = []
    for m in range(1, 13):
        end_date = pd.Period(f'2020-{m:02d}', 'M').end_time.date()
        act = len(drivers[drivers['join_date'].dt.date <= end_date])
        work = working_count.get(m, 0)
        pct = round(work * 100.0 / act, 2) if act > 0 else 0.0
        percentages.append(pct)
    months_df['working_percentage'] = percentages
    return months_df
